sentences.text: Emily Jean `` Emma '' Stone -LRB- born November 6 , 1988 -RRB- is an American actress .

One of the world 's highest-paid actresses in 2015 , Stone has received numerous accolades , including an Academy Award , a BAFTA Award , a Golden Globe Award and three Screen Actors Guild Awards .	numerous accolades	List of awards and nominations received by Emma Stone	Academy Award	Academy Award for Best Actress	BAFTA Award	BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Leading Role	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award
She appeared in Forbes Celebrity 100 in 2013 and the Time 100 in 2017 , and is often described by the media as one of the most talented actresses of her generation .
Born and raised in Scottsdale , Arizona , Stone began acting as a child , in a theater production of The Wind in the Willows in 2000 .	The Wind in the Willows	The Wind in the Willows

As a teenager , she relocated to Los Angeles with her mother , and made her television debut in VH1 's In Search of the New Partridge Family -LRB- 2004 -RRB- , a reality show that produced only an unsold pilot .	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	VH1	VH1	In Search of the New Partridge Family	The New Partridge Family

After small television roles , she won a Young Hollywood Award for her film debut in Superbad -LRB- 2007 -RRB- , and received positive media attention for her role in Zombieland -LRB- 2009 -RRB- .	Young Hollywood Award	Young Hollywood Awards	Superbad	Superbad (film)	Zombieland	Zombieland

The 2010 teen comedy Easy A was Stone 's first starring role and earned her nominations for the BAFTA Rising Star Award and a Golden Globe Award for Best Actress .	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award	Easy A	Easy A	BAFTA Rising Star Award	BAFTA Rising Star Award	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress	Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Motion Picture Comedy or Musical
